fullPassage: Triangle enthusiast Pythagoras thought a lot about music. He studied the lyre, a stringed instrument that was kind of a handheld harp, and developed the mathematics around how tone changes with string length. Strike a lyre string and you contribute energy to it, making the string vibrate at a particular frequency that's a function of its length; your ears experience that vibrating energy as a specific tone, like B-flat. Pythagoras believed that everything in the natural world was similarly ruled by math. When he looked up at the night sky, he didn't just see stars and planets — he saw an elegant equation at work. He believed that each planet emitted a different sound as it rotated and revolved, like the strings of a lyre, each contributes a unique celestial tone to a beautiful cosmic symphony. This concept became known as "the music of the spheres."

questions.passage: Triangle enthusiast Pythagoras thought a lot about music. He studied the lyre, a stringed instrument that was kind of a handheld harp, and developed the mathematics around how tone changes with string length. Strike a lyre string and you contribute energy to it, making the string vibrate at a particular frequency that's a function of its length; your ears experience that vibrating energy as a specific tone, like B-flat. Pythagoras believed that everything in the natural world was similarly ruled by math. When he looked up at the night sky, he didn't just see stars and planets — he saw <u>an elegant equation at work</u>. He believed that each planet emitted a different sound as it rotated and revolved, like the strings of a lyre, each contributes a unique celestial tone to a beautiful cosmic symphony. This concept became known as "the music of the spheres."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>an elegant equation at work</u>이(가) 다음 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 피타고라스가 밤하늘에서 인식한 '우아한 방정식이 작용 중인 것'의 의미를 파악한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a complex formula for calculating the speed of planets(행성 속도 계산 공식) — 속도 계산은 본문에서 다루지 않으며, 핵심은 수학적 질서/조화
❌ ② a musical score written by ancient Greek composers(고대 그리스 작곡가가 쓴 악보) — 실제 악보가 아니라 비유적 표현
❌ ③ a physical experiment conducted to measure starlight(별빛 측정 실험) — 실험이 아니라 피타고라스의 철학적 관점
✅ ④ mathematical laws governing the movements of celestial bodies(천체의 운동을 지배하는 수학적 법칙) — 피타고라스가 모든 자연이 수학에 의해 지배된다고 믿었고, 밤하늘에서 행성의 회전과 공전에 수학적 질서를 보았다는 맥락과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: 'elegant equation at work'는 수학적 법칙이 '실제로 작동하고 있다'는 비유입니다.
